segments.name: Investment income
segments.description: Invests in debt and equity securities of established lower middle market companies in the U.S. to earn investment income.
segments.evidence: Our current business strategy includes one reporting segment which derives investment income from our portfolio companies.

revenueModel.text: Borrowing portfolio companies pay the company interest and success fees on its debt investments.
revenueModel.evidence: We seek debt instruments that pay interest monthly or, at a minimum, quarterly, may have a success fee or deferred interest provision and are primarily interest only, with all principal and any accrued but unpaid interest due at maturity.
